features: HALF THE DEBT ON THE TENANT — A €1,000.00 arrears balance left behind by a property unit: the owner paid €500.00 and the other €500.00 landed on the tenant, who owes the building nothing because their relationship is with the landlord. The damage was twofold: the owner's share was diluted, because the calculation divided the debt by the thousandths of someone who should not have been paying at all. Nobody had reported it — it surfaced while re-reading the code against the document describing it, and that document already said the right thing.

DATABASE MIGRATION: the role column on a unit's occupants goes from a closed list to plain text, so it can hold one more role. No existing data changes, and anyone not using the new role will not notice this version.

THE UNIT'S ARREARS FALL ON WHOEVER OWES THEM. The tenant is out of the split: towards the building, the obligated party is whoever holds a real right over the unit. Among those, the nature of the management period decides — arrears from an ordinary period belong to the usufructuary (art. 1004 of the Italian Civil Code), those from an extraordinary period stay with the owner (art. 1005). On a unit held in full ownership, which is almost always the case, nothing changes.

IT IS A DEFAULT, NOT AN OBLIGATION. Towards the building, usufructuary and bare owner are jointly liable (art. 67 of the implementing provisions): the rule above is how it splits between them, and the parties may have agreed otherwise. For that case there is the manual split, now chosen while knowing what is being changed. There is also a new role, «Bare owner»: previously the only way to record bare ownership was to call it «Owner», and the system could not tell who pays ordinary expenses from who pays extraordinary ones.

SEE WHO WILL PAY BEFORE YOU GENERATE. When creating a plan, the automatic split of a unit's balance is now visible: which role bears it, which people, with what share and for how much. If no owner is active on that unit, the panel says so right there, while there is still time to record one, instead of letting the arrears vanish silently.

IF YOU HAVE ALREADY ISSUED: the fix applies to new plans; instalments already issued stay as they are, because they are an accounting document. The command «php artisan kondomanager:verifica-saldi-solidali» tells you whether and where you are affected without changing anything: it lists plan, unit, person, current role and amount for every charge that would be made differently today. To correct a plan: cancel the issue, recalculate, issue again.

Fixed — A UNIT'S CREDIT SPLIT MANUALLY BECAME A DEBT. Splitting €600.00 of credit between two co-owners produced two debts of €300.00: not a wrong amount, the opposite direction. The split field rightly forbids the minus sign, but nobody was putting it back: the system now reapplies it, from the original balance.

Fixed — RECORDING A PAYMENT USING A CREDIT COULD ANSWER WITH AN ERROR PAGE. The credit was counted twice when computing the advance, the balancing check refused, and the administrator lost the distribution they had just made by hand. Same effect when the available credit exceeded the debt: advances appeared that nobody had paid in.

Fixed — THE PAST-INVOICES PANEL MIXED UP TWO DIFFERENT THINGS. A unit's debts disappeared from the available provision, which could therefore read as zero while it was there, and a unit's credits appeared among debts to suppliers: money owed to an owner presented as money owed to a company.

Fixed — PLUS AND MINUS SAT ON OPPOSITE POLES in two screens of the same flow: when creating a plan the plus marked the credit, in Balances the debt. The plus now sits on the debt, always. Also fixed: a supplier debt showing up in plan creation as a unit balance headed «Unknown Unit», and the refusal to delete a management period holding supplier debts, which pointed to the «Balances» section where those debts do not appear.

Fixed — THREE DIFFERENT WAYS OF MAKING ARREARS VANISH SILENTLY, all closed: no owner on the unit, thousandths all at zero, and a distribution method outside the three supported ones. In all three the balance vanished and the plan closed anyway, declaring it had absorbed an amount it had charged to nobody.

BEHAVIOUR CHANGE — A manual split that does not add up to the balance is now refused: the warning existed but could be ignored, and the undistributed part stayed attached to the balance without being asked of anyone. The message states the size of the gap. And a payment that does not balance returns to the form with the error, with the data still filled in, instead of the server error page: the check is the same as before, what changes is how it presents itself.

Under the hood: the role vocabulary now lives in a single place, and with it the resolution chains, used by the balance split, the expense engine and direct charges, which previously each decided on their own with three different answers. The role column moves from ENUM to VARCHAR(50), so the next role will not cost a migration and the test schema stops being stricter than the production one. Penny-perfect splitting has a single primitive, using the largest-remainder method: who pays the rounding is decided by the calculation, not by the order in which the database returns rows. Fifty-two new tests — forty-four in PHP and eight in JavaScript — plus two that had been waiting a whole cycle for this migration and are green again.
